title: A test track in the desert
text: The Honda Proving Center of California, near Cantil, has a 7.5-mile oval track and a 5-mile winding road course. It was established in 1990 and used mainly to test Honda and Acura automobiles, though motorcycles are tested there too. Honda closed it in 2010 and moved testing to Marysville, Ohio, then announced in 2015 that it would renovate and expand it. The renovated center opened in May 2017.
